mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have 70 degree temperatures at Reddan Soccer Park with partly cloudy skies and a New Moon overhead.

There is important news for drivers, as road construction on Highway M begins August 18 with lane shifts and utility work planned. Also, the city is moving forward with development projects for the Plan Commission meeting on September 8.

We have plenty of activities to enjoy. Happening today, you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy live music at Concerts in the Park, or test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Looking at the weekly report, on August 8, the Verona Police Department assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office with a vehicle rollover crash where the driver attempted to flee but was ultimately arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Devil's Food Cake. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so be sure to stop by then to satisfy your craving.
